# Question: generator shortcuts

The strongest plausible canonical-fitting rival is **component-exact-only**:
recolor a green cross only when its entire 4-connected component is exactly the
five cells of that plus. It fits all five usable canonical input/output pairs,
because every canonical target is an isolated five-cell component.

A generated counterexample is the easy-band pair from seed
`233084910292910`, sample index `0`:

```text
input                 selected Racket output   component-exact-only
000033300             000033300                000033300
000033000             000033000                000033000
000000000             000000000                000000000
000000000             000000000                000000000
000033000             000037000                000033000
000033300             000077700                000033300
000003000             000007000                000003000
000000000             000000000                000000000
000000000             000000000                000000000
```

The lower target is a valid cardinal cross plus one attached corner cell, so its
component has size six. The intended local predicate recolors the center and
four arms and preserves the attachment; the rival leaves the whole component
green. The first disagreement is row 4, column 5 (zero-indexed): Racket gives 7,
the rival gives 3.

I checked this in the source-bound probe against the selected canonical Racket
authority (`RULE_HASH deb3ac96cc89`) and an independent Python mirror. The full
report is
`repo/generators/ebff81ea3252/workspace/lesson_probe_report.json`; it also
confirms the rival fits 5/5 canonical pairs and records the exact input, official
output, rival output, hashes, seed, and sample index.

**Yes, the repaired generator emits these cases.** Attached context is an exact
override and is also scheduled on every even default sample index. In the
retained 100-lessons-per-band census, attached targets occurred in 600/1,200
pairs and `component_exact_only` was refuted by the demonstrations in all
300/300 lessons.
